chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man forgot Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ until he returned to his family.
He عليه السلام said: "He should order that it be performed on his behalf if he is not going to perform hajj again, for women do not become permissible for him until he performs tawaf of the House."

key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf whose completion restores marital permissibility after hajj rites
key_terms.لَا تَحِلُّ لَهُ النِّسَاءُ: women remain impermissible to him in marital relations
key_terms.يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ: he performs tawaf around the Kaʿbah
key_terms.يُقْضَى عَنْهُ: it is performed on his behalf as a compensatory fulfillment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ and returns to his family?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ and returns home before performing it. The Imam عليه السلام states that marital permissibility does not return until the tawaf is completed, and if the person is not returning for hajj, it should be performed on his behalf.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2786 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot to perform Tawaf al-Nisa and returned to his family.
Imam (as) said: "He must arrange for someone to perform it on his behalf if he is not performing Hajj again. Women do not become permissible to him until he performs the tawaf of the Kaaba."
